product.title: Red Rock Canyon and Seven Magic Mountains Tour

description.text: Explore two of the most photogenic desert sights near Las Vegas on a guided small-group outing that pairs Red Rock Canyon scenery with a stop at Seven Magic Mountains. Travel with a guide, keep logistics simple, and spend more time at the viewpoints instead of planning your own route across the Mojave.

cancellationPolicy.description: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience starts (local time).

highlights: Visit Red Rock Canyon and Seven Magic Mountains in one guided day trip
Small-group format keeps the experience efficient and less crowded
Round-trip Las Vegas pickup helps simplify desert logistics
Great fit for travelers who want photogenic desert stops without self-driving
